title: Create Big Cannons: Security Breach
description: A bridge mod that enables Create Big Cannons projectiles to damage Security Craft reinforced blocks, replicating Rust-style siege mechanics.
body:
### Create Big Cannons: Security Breach
is a compatibility addon that allows Create Big Cannons to damage and destroy Security Craft blocks.
Requires Create Big Cannons and Security Craft.

### What's there?
Create Big Cannons: Security Breach currently has:
- **Artillery Breaching**: Removes the infinite explosion and physical resistance from Security Craft blocks when hit by heavy artillery.
- **Material-Based Durability**: Each reinforced block has its own unique health pool and explosive resistance determined by its specific material type.
- **Visual Damage States**: Remaining block health is dynamically tied to standard block crack stages, letting you see exactly how close each block is to collapsing.
- **Rust-Style Siege Mechanics**: Reinforced blocks now absorb kinetic energy and blast damage, requiring multiple cannon impacts to completely break depending on the block tier.
- **Server-Side Only**: Works perfectly in singleplayer or completely server-side. Players do not need to install this mod on their clients to join the server.
- **Balanced Raiding**: No more indestructible bedrock-like bases. Make your foes genuinely fear your custom automatic cannons and heavy payloads.

### What can I use this mod for?
This addon is mostly meant for multiplayer PvP and faction servers. Use your big cannons to breach fortified enemy bases, raid secure vaults, and bring true Rust-style tactical raiding to Minecraft!

### What dependencies are required?
[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), [Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons), and [SecurityCraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/security-craft) are required.

### Credits
Special thanks to the Security Craft team and rbasamoyai (creator of Create Big Cannons) for creating the original mods that made this addon possible.

Made by dinner.
